cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move our dinner booking. You came to cancel in person; you still hate disappointing me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the third time. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wouldn't apologise three times if I didn't matter. We'll make it an easy supper next Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop holding Fridays for me. I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, no Friday booking. You're still looking out for my weekends.

reason: Let A revise a real booking while misreading apologies and released Fridays as attachment; remove multiple reassurance/summary clauses and do not invent B agreement to another date.
